seoTitle: 🧑‍💼 Office Worker Emoji - What Does 🧑‍💼 Mean?
seoDescription: Learn what the office worker emoji 🧑‍💼 means in texts and social media.

longForm.overview:
The 🧑‍💼 Office Worker emoji was added in Unicode 12.1 (2019) and is drawn as a gender-neutral figure wearing a blue suit, white shirt, and tie. The visual cue reads instantly as office-coded worker, white-collar-coded default, or the visible 'business professional' tag. By 2026 🧑‍💼 has become the go-to emoji for the office-coded reaction, the visible white-collar default, and the professional-coded reaction in close-friends and family chats.

In modern chat 🧑‍💼 does very specific work. People send it as a literal office reference, as the visible 'business professional' tag, or as the desk-job-coded default. The blue suit and tie are the visual cue that the read is office-coded. Writers should pick 🧑‍💼 when the read is white-collar or visible 'desk job' energy, and avoid it when the read is factory worker — 🧑‍🏭 fits better there.
longForm.howPeopleUseIt:
🧑‍💼 lands on a friend's 'back to the office' message, in a work channel where someone is signaling desk-job energy, and in a family group where the sender is referencing a relative in corporate work. The blue suit and tie anchor the read.

In close-friends chats 🧑‍💼 reads as the universal office default and the visible 'business professional' tag. On X the emoji punctuates work-coded and office-coded tweets. The emoji pairs with 💼 for the layered worker-and-briefcase stack and with 🧑‍🏭 for the layered office-and-factory pair stack.
longForm.whenNotToUse: Skip 🧑‍💼 in any context where the read is factory worker. The blue suit implies office-coded, not industrial labor. Avoid 🧑‍💼 in contexts where the white-collar-coded read lands as out-of-touch.
longForm.howToReply:
If a friend sends 🧑‍💼 on a work-coded message, mirror with another 🧑‍💼 or 💼 to match the energy. The office chain reads as solidarity.

If 🧑‍💼 lands as the desk-job-coded default, reply with another 🧑‍💼 or ☕. And if you want to send 🧑‍💼 yourself, pair it with the moment so the office-coded read is clear.

faqs.question: What does 🧑‍💼 mean in text?
faqs.answer: 🧑‍💼 means office-coded worker, visible white-collar energy, or the business professional reaction. The blue suit and tie are the visual cue that the read is office-coded.

faqs.question: Is 🧑‍💼 flirty?
faqs.answer: Rarely. 🧑‍💼 usually reads as work-coded rather than flirty; in a dating thread it can read as 'business professional vibe' content.

faqs.question: What does 🧑‍💼 mean from a girl?
faqs.answer: From a girl or anyone, 🧑‍💼 carries the same office-coded read. There is no gendered meaning; the emoji works the same regardless.

faqs.question: What does 🧑‍💼 mean at work?
faqs.answer: In Slack, 🧑‍💼 reads as the visible 'desk job' default when paired with 'corporate life' content.
